newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli jets attack Hizbollah in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets attack Hizbollah in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes raided on Sunday suspected Hizbollah targets in southeast Lebanon few hours after the Moslem guerrillas wounded an Israeli soldier in the south, security sources said.
They said two jets fired in three swoops a total of six rockets into the hills overlooking Hizbollah-held Mashghara village just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties or damage in the raid.
The raid on the southern tip of the eastern Syrian-policed Bekaa Valley was the second Israeli strike on Lebanon in 24 hours and the 23rd since the beginning of the year.
Earlier on Sunday Hizbollah (Party of God) wounded an Israeli soldier and hit a Merkava tank in a rocket attack against an Israeli patrol on a road inside the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep zone.
This brought the number of Israeli casualties this year to five killed and 22 wounded.
Hizbollah is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 allied South Lebanon Army militiamen from the zone.
